Boston Children’s Museum.mobility: Building and exhibits are wheelchair accessible; the main elevator serves all three floors. Adult- and child-size manual wheelchairs are available first come.
Boston Children’s Museum.terrain: Indoor museum. Strollers are allowed, but parking is limited and some exhibits cannot accommodate them.
Boston Children’s Museum.sensory: Quieter areas, sound-reducing earmuffs, fidgets, weighted blankets and a pre-visit Social Story are available.
Boston Children’s Museum.visionHearing: Large-print maps and assistive listening devices are available; check the calendar for ASL-interpreted programs.
Boston Children’s Museum.restrooms: Wheelchair-accessible family restrooms are on all three floors.
Boston Children’s Museum.changing: A height-adjustable adult-size changing table is available in the first-aid room; ask staff to unlock it.
Boston Children’s Museum.parking: The museum validates selected nearby parking garages; confirm current garage details.

Discovery Museum.mobility: Museum building, exhibits, Discovery Woods and Treehouse are wheelchair accessible; two elevators serve the museum.
Discovery Museum.terrain: Discovery Woods has an accessible pathway. Snow or ice can affect the outdoor path in winter.
Discovery Museum.sensory: Noise-reducing headphones, sunglasses, sensory map, multilingual Social Story and a Take a Break space are available.
Discovery Museum.visionHearing: ASL interpretation can be requested with at least two weeks’ notice, subject to availability. Especially for Me includes Deaf, Blind and DeafBlind programming.
Discovery Museum.restrooms: Accessible family restroom on the first floor; additional accessible restrooms on first and second floors.
Discovery Museum.changing: All five restrooms have changing tables. Adult-size changing equipment was not confirmed in the current public information reviewed.
Discovery Museum.parking: Accessible parking spaces are near the rear of the building.
Discovery Museum.weather: Outdoor Discovery Woods is weather-sensitive and closes at sunset.
Discovery Museum.evidence: Organizer accessibility and plan-your-visit pages checked Oct 3, 2026.

Montshire Museum of Science.terrain: Science Park includes loose gravel. Some trails use compacted crushed stone, dirt, pine needles and wood chips; an all-terrain chair/jogger can help in some outdoor areas.
Montshire Museum of Science.sensory: Sensory Hour reduces sound on select exhibits, limits visitors and offers respite space/sensory supplies.
Montshire Museum of Science.visionHearing: Current public information reviewed focused mainly on mobility and sensory access; confirm specific low-vision/hearing supports.
Montshire Museum of Science.changing: Adult-size changing equipment was not confirmed.
Montshire Museum of Science.parking: Confirm the easiest accessible arrival route before travel.
Montshire Museum of Science.weather: Outdoor trails and surfaces can change with weather.
Montshire Museum of Science.evidence: Organizer FAQ and trail-access notes checked Oct 3, 2026.

freePrograms.summary: Free sensory-friendly performances reserved for people with sensory sensitivities. Beautiful: The Carole King Musical is listed for October 31, 2026, at 2 p.m. Reserve through the box office: 475-215-5497 or boxoffice@actofct.org. The ending time is not published.

freePrograms.name: JCC Greater Boston sensory swim
freePrograms.summary: Free for members and nonmembers. All ages with sensory needs can attend with family or caregivers; each session requires registration. See the dated swim listings above.

freePrograms.name: Discovery Museum — Especially for Me
freePrograms.summary: Free access sessions for families and groups who benefit from accommodations. Advance registration is required; a medical diagnosis is not.

freePrograms.name: Special Olympics Massachusetts recreational sports
freePrograms.summary: No participation fee for athletes. Programs are designed for people with intellectual disabilities; ask about local sessions and support needs.

freePrograms.name: Maine Adaptive
freePrograms.summary: Free adaptive lessons, equipment and required lift or trail passes. Ages 4+ with permanent physical or cognitive disabilities; activity-specific criteria apply. Apply before requesting lessons. Some specialty programs require a refundable deposit.

freePrograms.name: Children’s Museum & Theatre of Maine — Play Your Way
freePrograms.summary: Free sensory-friendly play sessions. The October 30 Halloween session runs 4:30–6:30 p.m.; reservations are recommended. Parking may cost extra.

freePrograms.name: SEE Science Center sensory-friendly night
freePrograms.summary: Free on November 6, 2026, 5–7 p.m., with advance registration for every attendee. Reduced stimulation and a break room are part of this session.

freePrograms.name: Community Libraries of Providence sensory storytime
freePrograms.summary: Free library programming with stories, movement and sensory supports. Recommended for ages 0–5, with all ages welcome; see dated listings for the Mt. Pleasant branch.

freePrograms.name: Special Olympics Rhode Island
freePrograms.summary: Year-round training and competition are free for athletes and their families. Contact the program for local teams, registration and intellectual-disability eligibility.

freePrograms.name: Montshire Museum — Montshh… Sensory Hour
freePrograms.summary: Free sensory hours for children, teens, adults and families. Reduced sound, a respite space and visual planning supports are available; see dated listings.

freePrograms.name: Wings for Autism — Charles River Center
freePrograms.summary: Free airport rehearsals for families of children with autism. Boston Logan: November 7, 2026, 9 a.m.–noon. Register all attendees in advance.

freePrograms.name: NEHSA Adaptive Bike Demo Day
freePrograms.summary: Free adaptive cycling tryout at Mount Sunapee in Newbury on October 24, 2026, 11 a.m.–2 p.m., with lunch provided. Register through NEHSA; other NEHSA activities may have fees.

freePrograms.name: Autism Flies — T. F. Green
freePrograms.summary: Free airport boarding practice with Breeze Airways, announced for November 2026. Request an invitation and confirm the full schedule before making travel plans.

freePrograms.name: Autism Flies — Bradley
freePrograms.summary: Free airport boarding practice with Breeze Airways, announced for spring 2027. An invitation request is available; the final date and time are not published.

freePrograms.name: AANE Outdoor Enthusiasts
freePrograms.summary: Free monthly outdoor outings for autistic adults in Greater Boston and southeastern Massachusetts. Join the private Meetup group for the next date; parking may cost extra.

freePrograms.name: Friends in Action Friday Night Socials
freePrograms.summary: Free social nights for high-school-age participants and adults. Intake is required; bring needed 1:1 support. Bowling, meals, movie tickets and some other programs have charges.

freePrograms.name: Zack’s Place weekday enrichment
freePrograms.summary: Free arts, music, adaptive sports and outings in Woodstock for people of all ages with disabilities. Arrange a first visit and bring a caregiver for personal-care needs.
